title: The garage, ii
venue: Arthur's site (newspaper cadence: six dailies + a Sunday)
logline: Tuesday. The tavern in front. The jukebox through the wall, drawn as a shape in the plaster. The dog listens to it. Wood draws to it. Nobody names the song or the tavern.

panels.composition: The garage, night. The wall shared with the tavern. Through it: a jukebox, drawn as a wobbling shape in the plaster, music lines coming off it. BARNABY with his ear to the wall.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, a garage studio at night where a jukebox is drawn as a wobbling shape inside the shared plaster wall with music lines coming off it, a small dog with its ear pressed to the wall

panels.composition: WOOD at the drafting table, drawing in time with it. His pen hand bouncing.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, a man at a drafting table drawing with his pen hand bouncing to unseen music

panels.composition: The table. One leg short. A wobble line. The coffee ripples.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, close-up of a drafting table with one short leg wobbling and coffee rippling in a mug
image.notes: The uneven table, day two. The 2007 letter fixes it.

panels.composition: The music stops. Wood and the dog both look at the wall. The wall is a wall.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, a man and a small dog both looking at a blank plaster wall in sudden silence, no words

art.line: brush-pen scanned; muddy early-digital flats begin
art.palette: limited, muddy; Sundays in over-wet watercolor

notes: The jukebox in the plaster. The table wobbles. The tavern unnamed.
